sections.description: AutoRepair AI Hosting Beta. Pre-update protection, full-site backup and restore, isolated restore verification, proof reports, hub management, usage and billing display, and a built-in diagnostic panel. USD-based billing display.
sections.changelog:
0.20.27

  • Fix the stale version labels in the app header and the recovery vault hero: both printed a hard-coded build number (0.20.13 / 0.20.20), so every release showed an old number. They now read the plugin version constant.
  • Align the package version strings (plugin header, version constant, asset version, readme Stable tag, distribution note) to 0.20.27.

0.20.26

  • English pass 2: every remaining screen internationalized - repair, recovery, vault admin/io/db/test/guard/full/command, business checks, reports, workspace, dashboard, notifications, onboarding, partner API, diagnostics, compatibility, backup jobs, billing, verification.

0.20.20

  • vault-admin.php (Backup and restore) translated to English.

0.20.19

  • value.php (Value and support) translated to English.
  • Connection settings are mirrored in encrypted form and restored automatically when they are wiped.
  • A 409 sequence_conflict is now realigned and retried automatically.

0.20.18

  • control-center.php translated to English.
